svg.title: From next-token prediction to agentic AI
svg.desc: Four stages of a chat system (untrained, pre-trained, assistant, tool-using agent) and the three steps between them (pre-training, post-training, tools + agent loop).

g.text: From next-token prediction to agentic AI
One question, four systems. Each step builds on the one before.
A harness runs tools for the
Completes text, not yet an assistant
What do recent papers say ab…
Can retrieve and act; needs oversight
Next-token prediction runs underneath every stage: later steps build on it, they don't replace it
Simplified teaching model, not a strict historical or architectural sequence. Words stand in for tokens (real tokens can also be word fragments or punctuation). Example outputs are schematic.
